title: Scaffold Business Review Generator agent (Phase 1, Agent #3)
spec:
Build the complete Business Review Generator agent per AI Factory standards. This is Phase 1 Agent #3, T2 (HITL). The directory agents/business-review-generator/ already exists with only AGENT_CARD.md.

## Purpose
On-demand CLI agent that pulls delivery and account data from Helix + Salesforce, computes metrics, runs 4 LLM passes to generate a structured QBR/EBR draft, saves it locally, and sends a Webex notification. SDM/CXM reviews and approves every draft — agent NEVER sends to customer.

## CLI Invocation
```bash
python main.py --account "Acme Corp" --quarter Q2-2026 [--dry-run] [--format md]
```

## Processing Steps
1. Pull period data:
   - Helix REST API: milestones, entitlements, SLA records (✅ Ready)
   - Salesforce MCP: cases, CSAT scores (🟡 Pending ops access — implement with stub/mock that returns empty data gracefully when SALESFORCE_MCP_TOKEN is unset)
   - Also load latest Delivery Tracker JSON from data/runs/delivery-tracker/ as supplementary input
2. Compute metrics: case velocity, SLA compliance %, milestone on-time %, entitlement utilization %
3. Four LLM passes (use LiteLLM via env-configured model — default to a template string if LLM_MODEL not set):
   - Pass 1: Executive summary (3–5 sentences, business language)
   - Pass 2: Delivery performance narrative
   - Pass 3: Risk & issues section
   - Pass 4: Next quarter priorities + recommendations
4. Validate: every metric in LLM output must trace back to a source data field — flag any section where source data was missing
5. Populate templates/business-review-template.md with rendered sections
6. Save draft: data/runs/business-review/YYYY-MM-DD-{account_slug}.md
7. Send Webex notification (if WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN set and not --dry-run): "Draft QBR for [Account] ready — ~30 min review"
8. Print [METRICS] at end of run()

- agents/business-review-generator/models.py (AccountPeriodData, CaseMetrics, MilestoneMetrics, EntitlementMetrics, QBRSection, QBRDraft Pydantic models)
- agents/business-review-generator/data_collector.py (DataCollector class: fetch_helix_data, fetch_salesforce_data — stub returns empty SalesforceData when token unset, load_delivery_tracker_json)
- agents/business-review-generator/metrics_calculator.py (MetricsCalculator class: compute_case_velocity, compute_sla_compliance, compute_milestone_ontime, compute_utilization — returns dict with source field citations)
- agents/business-review-generator/llm_writer.py (LLMWriter class: four methods for each pass — falls back to template strings when LLM_MODEL unset or --dry-run)
- agents/business-review-generator/reviewer.py (BusinessReviewGenerator class: trust_tier="T2", validate_inputs(), handle_error(), run(account, quarter))
- agents/business-review-generator/main.py (CLI: --account, --quarter, --format, --dry-run flags; argparse)
- agents/business-review-generator/templates/business-review-template.md (structured QBR template with section placeholders: Executive Summary, Delivery Performance, Risk & Issues, Next Quarter Priorities, Data Sources)
- agents/business-review-generator/tools/brg_tools.py (tool wrappers: collect_account_data, compute_qbr_metrics, generate_qbr_draft, get_draft_summary)
- agents/business-review-generator/tests/conftest.py (fixtures: mock_settings, sample_account_data, sample_metrics, sample_qbr_draft)

- agents/business-review-generator/tests/test_metrics.py (one test per metric function; verify source citations present in output)
- agents/business-review-generator/.env.example
- agents/business-review-generator/requirements.txt
- agents/business-review-generator/README.md

## AI Factory Class Requirements (reviewer.py)
- trust_tier = "T2"
- validate_inputs(account, quarter): raises ValueError if account is empty string or HELIX_API_TOKEN missing
- handle_error(exc): logs + re-raises
- run(account, quarter): calls validate_inputs(), wraps in try/except, prints [METRICS] on ALL exit paths including errors

## LLM Fallback Pattern
If LLM_MODEL is not set or dry_run=True, each LLM pass returns a clearly marked placeholder:
```
[DRAFT — REVIEW REQUIRED]
Executive Summary: Data collected for {account} covering {quarter}.
[LLM generation skipped — set LLM_MODEL in .env to enable]
```

## Standards
- All credentials via .env only — HELIX_API_TOKEN, SALESFORCE_MCP_TOKEN, WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN never hardcoded
- HTTPS for all external API calls; timeout=15 on all HTTP requests
- Draft files saved to data/runs/business-review/ — create dir if not exists
- Patch targets for tests: reviewer.DataCollector, reviewer.LLMWriter, reviewer.MetricsCalculator
- Reference .cursor/rules/ai-factory-standards.md for agent class pattern
- Reference agents/delivery-tracker/tracker.py and agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/sentinel.py as style reference
